picks.name: Dengue Dengue Dengue
picks.source_note: Already in your library (Bass/slow playlists). New album on Club Romantico -- a different release and label from their August "Abisal" EP on Kebrada.
picks.bio: "Vestigio" (October 22, 2026, Club Romantico) is a 10-track album from Lima duo Felipe Salmon and Rafael Pereira, mastered by Loric Sih -- their most radical reworking yet of polyrhythm and traditional Peruvian textures, with features from Los Hijos De Lamas ("Pantano") and Siete Catorce ("Señal").
picks.why_listen: Dense, percussion-forward bass music that still carries their signature tropical/psychedelic edge -- a fresh full-length from an artist already proven in your sets, one day old.
